annotations.text: Single user. The left panel carries the one-line description from the brief — it is the only place the product explains itself.
Sign-up closes once the account exists. The checkbox is the only place the product asks anything of you before you start.
Review has left the sidebar: Today, Objectives, Deviations, Parking lot.\nA review is something you do to an objective, not a place you visit.
Carries the combined picture — where every hour in September went, including drift and objectives since ended.
Opens with what is already parked, before the form.
Parked / Taken / Dropped. Nothing is deleted; the pair of reasons on a dropped row is the point.
Effort is gone from Overview — it has its own tab. In its place: status history with the reason given at each change, then the status actions below the schedule.
A weekly review, scoped to its own week. No decision here — status changes happen on the objective. It ends in a summary that appears against the week in the reviews list.
The stress case: extended three times, completed with criteria only partly met. Overview shows how long it really took and adherence falling window on window.
Effort tab. Four months, shown a month at a time, every day against its target.
Reviews tab. Four rows, the adherence trend beneath, and the sentence that repeats across three of them.
One frozen review with its own address. Everything that was true on 22 Nov: figures, drift and its verdicts, parked ideas, the plan note, the reflection and the decision.
The only status change that opens a dialog. It needs a new schedule, so it cannot be an inline panel.
Added after your answer to Q2. Same confirmation whether or not the address has an account; if the mailbox is gone too, the account cannot be recovered.
